Hymn 258: O Thou Rock of Our Salvation
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Joseph J. Daynes
Lyricist/Text Author: Joseph L. Townsend
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 258 titled "O Thou Rock of Our Salvation" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph J. Daynes and the lyrics were written by Joseph L. Townsend.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
